hierarchy.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-500 bg-neutral-50/80

layout.structure: Fixed Sidebar + Scrollable Main Content Area
layout.sidebar: w-72 border-r border-neutral-200 bg-neutral-50/50 flex flex-col h-screen sticky top-0
layout.spacing: p-8 for main sections, gap-6 between layout blocks, py-2 px-3 for dense table cells

components.button_primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm bg-[#BE123C] text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-[#9F1239] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#BE123C]
components.button_secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-neutral-200 bg-white text-neutral-900 font-medium px-5 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-neutral-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-neutral-200
components.input: flex h-11 w-full rounded-sm border border-neutral-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm text-neutral-900 placeholder:text-neutral-400 transition-all focus:border-[#BE123C] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#BE123C]
components.badge: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-800

features.input_section: Top of main area. Clean, wide input field with a prominent 'Scrape' button beside it.
features.loading_state: Table row skeletons (h-10) with animate-pulse. Disable input and button while loading. Show 'Extracting scorecard...' text.
features.error_state: Clear error message below the input field in red (#DC2626). Must gracefully handle generic extraction errors vs Cloudflare blocks.
features.history_sidebar: Left sidebar displaying previously scraped scorecards. List items should show truncated match title, date/time, and a 'View' & 'Delete' action on hover.
features.preview_section: Rendered below the input after successful scrape. Show Match Info (Title, Venue, Result) in a clean header. Use Tabs (Innings 1, Innings 2) or stacked dense tables for Batting and Bowling. Keep columns compact.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors are deliberately high contrast (900 and 500).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='url-input', data-testid='scrape-button', data-testid='download-csv-btn', data-testid='history-item', data-testid='history-delete-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all components. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Adopt a 'Linear/Retool' aesthetic: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), stark white backgrounds, dense layouts, and highly visible data.
Do not wrap data tables in bloated Card components. Use the 'table_container' styles provided to keep tables looking like a native spreadsheet/data grid.
Use IBM Plex Mono for numerical data in tables (Runs, Balls, 4s, 6s, SR, Economy) to ensure perfect vertical alignment of digits.
In the preview, visually separate the Batting table and Bowling table within an innings using generous vertical spacing (e.g., mt-8) or distinct subheadings.
Format the CSV download so all data (Match Info, Innings 1 Batting/Bowling, Innings 2 Batting/Bowling) is logically sequenced into a single file.
Use the Crimson accent color (#BE123C) sparingly. It represents the cricket ball and should only be used for primary actions (Scrape button, active tab states, focus rings).
